verses.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: From Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy — to the church of the Thessalonians, which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace and peace to You from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.modern: We always thank God for You all, mentioning You in our prayers,

verses.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
verses.modern: constantly remembering before our God and Father Your work that flows from faith, Your labor that flows from love, and Your patient endurance that flows from hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
verses.modern: We know, brethren loved by God, that He has chosen You.

verses.kjv: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.modern: Our gospel did not come to You in word only, but also in power, in the Holy Ghost, and with deep conviction. You know the kind of men we were among You for Your sake.

verses.kjv: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
verses.modern: And You became followers of us and of the Lord, receiving the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Ghost,

verses.kjv: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.modern: so that You became examples to all who believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
verses.modern: For from You the word of the Lord has rung out — not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place. Your faith toward God has spread so far that we do not need to say anything.

verses.kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
verses.modern: People themselves report about us what kind of welcome we had among You, and how You turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,

verses.kjv: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
verses.modern: and to wait for His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead — Jesus, Who delivers us from the wrath to come.

chapters.summary: Paul gives thanks for the Thessalonians, remembering their work of faith, labour of love, and patience of hope in the Lord Jesus Christ. He recalls how the gospel came to them not in word only but also in power and in the Holy Ghost, and how they turned from idols to serve the living and true God and to wait for His Son from heaven.

verses.kjv: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
verses.modern: For you yourselves, brethren, know that our coming to you was not in vain.

verses.kjv: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
verses.modern: Though we had already suffered and been shamefully treated at Philippi, as you know, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God in the face of strong opposition.

verses.kjv: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
verses.modern: For our appeal was not made out of deceit, or uncleanness, or trickery.

verses.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
verses.modern: But just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak — not to please men, but God, Who tests our hearts.

verses.kjv: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
verses.modern: For we never used flattering words, as you know, nor any cover-up for greed — God is our witness.

verses.kjv: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
verses.modern: Nor did we seek glory from men — not from You, nor from anyone else — though as apostles of Christ we could have made demands of You.

verses.kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
verses.modern: Instead, we were gentle among You, like a nursing mother caring for her own children.

verses.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
verses.modern: Because we loved You so dearly, we were delighted to share with You not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well, because You had become dear to us.

verses.kjv: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
verses.modern: For You remember, brethren, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of You while we preached the gospel of God to You.

verses.kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
verses.modern: You are witnesses, and God is also, how holy, just, and blameless our conduct was among You who believe —

verses.kjv: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
verses.modern: just as You know how, like a father with His own children, we exhorted, comforted, and charged every one of you,

verses.kjv: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
verses.modern: that You would walk worthy of God, Who has called You into His own kingdom and glory.

verses.kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
verses.modern: For this reason we also thank God without ceasing: when You received the word of God which You heard from us, You welcomed it not as the word of men, but as it truly is — the word of God, which is at work in You who believe.

verses.kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
verses.modern: For You, brethren, became followers of the churches of God in Judaea that are in Christ Jesus. You have suffered the same things from Your own countrymen that they have suffered from the Jews —

verses.kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
verses.modern: the Jews who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and have driven us out. They do not please God, and they are hostile to all men,

verses.kjv: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.modern: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles so that they might be saved. So they keep filling up the measure of their sins; but the wrath has come upon them at last.

verses.kjv: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
verses.modern: But we, brethren, having been torn away from You for a short time — in presence, not in heart — were all the more eager and full of desire to see Your face again.

verses.kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
verses.modern: Therefore we wanted to come to you — I, Paul, again and again — but Satan hindered us.

verses.kjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
verses.modern: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Is it not You — in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at His coming?

verses.kjv: For ye are our glory and joy.
verses.modern: For You are our glory and joy.

chapters.summary: Paul reminds the Thessalonians that he and his companions were bold to speak the gospel amid much opposition, never using flattery or seeking glory from men. He recalls how he was gentle among them as a nursing mother cherishes her children, and how the Thessalonians received the word not as the word of men but as the word of God, which effectually works in those who believe.

verses.kjv: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
verses.modern: Therefore, when we could no longer endure not knowing, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone,

verses.kjv: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
verses.modern: and we sent Timothy — our brother and a minister of God and our fellow worker in the gospel of Christ — to strengthen You and comfort You concerning Your faith,

verses.kjv: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
verses.modern: so that no one would be shaken by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed to this.

verses.kjv: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
verses.modern: For truly, when we were with You, we told You in advance that we were going to suffer tribulation, just as it has happened — and You know it.

verses.kjv: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
verses.modern: For this reason, when I could no longer endure not knowing, I sent to find out about Your faith — fearing that the tempter might have tempted You and that our labor would be in vain.

verses.kjv: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
verses.modern: But now Timothy has just come back to us from you, and has brought us good news of your faith and charity. He tells us that you remember us kindly always, longing to see us, just as we also long to see you.

verses.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
verses.modern: Therefore, brethren, in all our distress and affliction we were comforted concerning you by your faith.

verses.kjv: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
verses.modern: For now we live — if you stand fast in the Lord.

verses.kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
verses.modern: For what thanks can we give back to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice over you before our God,

verses.kjv: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.modern: as night and day we pray most earnestly that we might see your face and supply what is lacking in your faith?

verses.kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
verses.modern: Now may God Himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to You.

verses.kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
verses.modern: And may the Lord make You increase and overflow in love toward one another, and toward all men, just as we do toward You,

verses.kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
verses.modern: so that He may establish Your hearts blameless in holiness before God, our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.

chapters.summary: Paul sent Timothy to Thessalonica to strengthen and encourage the believers in their afflictions, and Timothy returned with good news of their faith and love. Paul expresses great joy over their steadfastness and prays night and day that he may see them again and supply what is lacking in their faith.

verses.kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
verses.modern: Finally then, brethren, we appeal to You and urge You in the Lord Jesus that, just as You received from us how You ought to walk and to please God, You would do so more and more.

verses.kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
verses.modern: For You know what commandments we gave You through the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
verses.modern: For this is the will of God — your sanctification: that You abstain from fornication,

verses.kjv: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
verses.modern: that each of You should know how to control His own body in sanctification and honor,

verses.kjv: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
verses.modern: not in the lust of evil desire, like the Gentiles who do not know God;

verses.kjv: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
verses.modern: and that no man overstep or take advantage of His brother in this matter, because the Lord is the avenger of all such sins, as we have already warned You and solemnly testified.

verses.kjv: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
verses.modern: For God has not called us to uncleanness, but to holiness.

verses.kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
verses.modern: Therefore the one who rejects this teaching is not rejecting man, but God — who has also given to us His Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
verses.modern: Now concerning brotherly love, You have no need that I write to You, for You yourselves are taught by God to love one another.

verses.kjv: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
verses.modern: And indeed You do this toward all the brethren throughout Macedonia. But we appeal to You, brethren, to do so more and more —

verses.kjv: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
verses.modern: and to make it Your ambition to lead a quiet life, to mind Your own business, and to work with Your own hands, just as we commanded You,

verses.kjv: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
verses.modern: so that You may walk honorably toward those who are outside, and that You may lack nothing.

verses.kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
verses.modern: But I would not have You ignorant, brethren, concerning those who are asleep, so that You do not grieve like the rest of men, who have no hope.

verses.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
verses.modern: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, in the same way God will bring with Him those also who sleep in Jesus.

verses.kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
verses.modern: For this we say to You by the word of the Lord: we who are alive and remain to the coming of the Lord shall not precede those who are asleep.

verses.kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
verses.modern: For the Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God; and the dead in Christ shall rise first.

verses.kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.modern: Then we who are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air; and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

verses.kjv: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.modern: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

chapters.summary: Paul urges the Thessalonians to abstain from fornication, to live quietly, work with their own hands, and walk honestly toward those outside. He comforts them concerning the dead in Christ, declaring that the Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, and the dead in Christ shall rise first, then the living shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air.

verses.kjv: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
verses.modern: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, You have no need that anything be written to You.

verses.kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
verses.modern: For You yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.

verses.kjv: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
verses.modern: When they shall say, "Peace and safety," then sudden destruction comes upon them, like labor pains upon a woman with child — and they shall not escape.

verses.kjv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.modern: But You, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake You like a thief.

verses.kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
verses.modern: You are all children of light and children of the day. We are not of the night or of darkness.

verses.kjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
verses.modern: Therefore let us not sleep as others do, but let us watch and be sober.

verses.kjv: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.modern: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

verses.kjv: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.modern: But let us, who are of the day, be sober — putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet the hope of salvation.

verses.kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.modern: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.kjv: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.modern: who died for us, so that whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with Him.

verses.kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
verses.modern: Therefore encourage one another and build one another up, just as You are already doing.

verses.kjv: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
verses.modern: And we appeal to You, brethren, to recognize those who labor among You, and are over You in the Lord, and admonish You,

verses.kjv: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
verses.modern: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

verses.kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
verses.modern: Now we urge You, brethren, warn those who are unruly, comfort the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all men.

verses.kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
verses.modern: See that no one repays evil for evil to anyone; but always pursue what is good, both among yourselves and toward all.

verses.kjv: Rejoice evermore.
verses.modern: Rejoice always.

verses.kjv: Pray without ceasing.
verses.modern: Pray without ceasing.

verses.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.modern: In everything give thanks. For this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning You.

verses.kjv: Quench not the Spirit.
verses.modern: Do not quench the Spirit.

verses.kjv: Despise not prophesyings.
verses.modern: Do not despise prophesyings.

verses.kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.modern: Test all things; hold fast what is good.

verses.kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
verses.modern: Abstain from every appearance of evil.

verses.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: And the very God of peace sanctify You wholly; and may Your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
verses.modern: Faithful is He who calls you, who also will do it.

verses.kjv: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.modern: Brethren, pray for us.

verses.kjv: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
verses.modern: Greet all the brethren with a holy kiss.

verses.kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
verses.modern: I charge You by the Lord that this epistle be read to all the holy brethren.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.modern: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with You. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul warns that the day of the Lord comes as a thief in the night, bringing sudden destruction on those who say "peace and safety," but believers are children of the light and should watch and be sober. He gives final instructions: rejoice evermore, pray without ceasing, give thanks in everything, quench not the Spirit, prove all things, and hold fast that which is good.
